The S5 migration idempotence harness: applies all pending omarchy
migrations at BUILD time (a candy run step — the install timeline, as
root) and asserts the idempotence: no migrations remain pending after
the build-time run (omarchy-migrate --pending exits 1), and a second
migrate run is a no-op (exit 0). The deliberately broken migration
variant (omarchy-migration-harness-red) adds a migration that never
creates its marker — the harness catches it (it stays pending).
